days.label: Day 1
days.title: Meet your hosts
days.text: Drive up to your family-run homestay near Kalimpong. Home-cooked dinner with the family.

days.label: Day 2
days.title: Hills and nurseries
days.text: Deolo Hill viewpoint, cactus and orchid nurseries, and Durpin Dara.

days.label: Day 3
days.title: Birds and bazaar
days.text: Early birdwatching walk with a local guide, then the Kalimpong market and monasteries.

days.label: Day 4
days.title: Departure
days.text: Breakfast with the family and a drop to NJP or Bagdogra.
